skills.trigger: When evaluating follow-up chest radiographs for changes in cavitary lung disease.
steps: Compare the current image to the baseline study to assess changes in the number and size of intrapulmonary cavities (lucent areas with walls).
Inspect the interior of identified cavities for horizontal air-fluid levels (distinct flat interface between air and fluid), which indicate progression or superinfection compared to dry cavities.
